description: Routing / directions: compute the distance and travel time between two points for a given travel mode (drive, walk, bicycle, transit). Returns distance in meters and time in seconds. Example: routing({ from_lat: 48.8584, from_lon: 2.2945, to_lat: 48.8606, to_lon: 2.3376, mode: "drive" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Geoapify API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

name: routing
